notes: Test dataset for the Thailand men's senior squad named for the 52nd King's Cup in November 2026; not all 23 are confirmed starters.
Permanent Player IDs assigned for this explicitly approved test after identity matching against the published squad.
Club and national-team statistics remain separate and must never be combined.
Unknown statistics remain null and must display as an em dash, not zero.
Current clubs reflect the 15 November 2026 squad article and require re-verification before production use.
No unverified player photos or club crests were added; neutral placeholders are intentional.
National-team appearances, goals and assists use career totals across the player's senior international career; unknown totals remain null.
National-team statistics period is career lifetime (senior national team); club statistics remain season 2026/27.
